rulings.restated: Enter the amount from helper "Qualified expenses incurred and paid in 2025 for this person's care".
rulings.model: The IRS says, “If you completed Part III, don't include in column (d) any benefits shown on line 28.” The helper includes expenses paid with dependent care benefits without subtracting those excluded or deducted benefits from this line.
rulings.ruling: Ruling: ambiguity; amb.2025.dc_line30 (owner ruling, Stage 15 decision 6, T-048). i2441 p. 3, Column (d): "If you completed Part III, don't include in column (d) any benefits shown on line 28"; Form 2441 line 30, "Don't include in column (d) any benefits shown on line 28 above. Then, add the amounts in column (d) and enter the total here"; the instructions give no rule for dividing line 28 among persons. The model reads the register's rejected reading (column (d) net of benefits). This round's dependent.dc_paid wording (T-184 household services, housekeeper meals and lodging, transportation, fees, volunteer work; T-123 the value of employer-furnished care left out, "paid by your employer to a provider you chose") does not change how benefits are treated, and dependent.dc_line2d is unchanged. As ruled since fix round 2. Project stands.
